'''2001 California State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in California in 2001.<ref name="dt-15893">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15893 All For Her v1 3], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 11 May 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15893/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15893/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2001 (before 11 May)
* '''Site:''' California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' —

The event is known from players' DeckTech posts; they give no exact date. It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.

Stefanko's Light Rescue The Princess deck, mains backed with high destiny and retrieval, went 3–1 at the California State Championship.<ref name="dt-15893" />
